Roundabout

(Published on 18. October 2026, 15:44 by Phistomefel)
This puzzle is a thermo sudoku with a special constraint concerning the perimeter of the grid. Here are the rules:
  1. Normal thermo sudoku rules apply.
  2. Move along the perimeter cells in clockwise direction. From a cell on the perimeter, you move X steps clockwise where X is the digit in that cell.
  3. No matter which perimeter cell you start from, you will return to it at some point following rule 2 for every cell you reach.
The following example illustrates how rules 2 and 3 can look like. The numbers in the top left corners of the cells display the order of the positions when starting in row 1, column 1.


The puzzle is also available online via the CTC-App. Have fun solving!
